resources.string: Unreel hides the Instagram Reels tab, closes Reels when they open and blocks TikTok. It only looks at the screen of those apps and has no internet access, so it can\'t send any data anywhere.
Unreel hides the Reels button in Instagram, closes Reels when they open (from the feed, Explore or DMs) and blocks TikTok.
⛔ Unreel is not active yet – follow the steps below

Android blocks this for apps that don\'t come from the Play Store, so this first attempt is expected to fail – it unlocks the next step.\n\nTap the button, tap \"Unreel – Reels blocker\" (it\'s greyed out) and close the \"Restricted setting\" popup.
Tap the button, then tap ⋮ in the top-right corner and choose \"Allow restricted settings\". Confirm with your PIN or fingerprint.\n\nDon\'t see that option? Do step 1 first.
Tap the button, open \"Unreel – Reels blocker\" (under \"Downloaded apps\"), turn on the switch and tap \"Allow\".
Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery, which would turn the blocker off. Tap the button and choose \"Allow\".
Close Instagram Reels when they open
Unreel only reacts to the Instagram and TikTok screens. It has no internet permission, so nothing you see ever leaves your phone.
